text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm out and about town...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sigh... They look so soft and fluffy! Maybe today's the day I... No, it's not like me to do something like this...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I need to get home fast. If someone
sees me
here—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah! Y-you're one of the academy's
trainers!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aw, man... You saw everything, didn't
you? I
guess anyone would stick out like
a sore thumb
making a fuss in front of a
cat cafe!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, I just stumbled across
this place
and was thinking of going
inside for a bit...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But I suppose I should give it up for
today.
Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Urk! It's fine! Just looking at the cats is
enough to
soothe my sou—
choice_data_list: Tell her that taking time to unwind is important too.
Explain a clever way to enter the shop

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nope. Never mind. I didn't mean to take
another
look, but I did, and the last nail
just entered my
coffin.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, how can I say no after seeing
those big,
sparkling eyes staring at me
through the window?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's like the kitty's calling for me... And it
would
be rude to ignore such a sincere
invitation! Well,
here I go, then!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... They were sooo cute... So
fluffy-wuffy and
soft...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That does it! I'm going all out in training

tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature leaves the cat cafe feeling
so
refreshed and healed that she's
practically
glowing with radiance.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? They're doing a promotion for
first-time
visitors?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you're right! It's written on that
board too.
And I can even get cat treats
for free if I use the
smartphone coupon.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hm... My reputation as a coupon
collector would
be ruined if I let this
incredible deal slip through
my fingers!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Right! I have no choice but to go into
the cafe!
Oh dear, woe is me! ♪
